Extreme cold! The electric shower can reach 30%% of your bill in winter. Cut down shower time.
Heaters Avoid leaving electric heaters on all night — use extra blankets instead.
Watch your shower Cold days increase electric shower usage. Keep showers shorter.
Mild weather Great chance for natural ventilation instead of air conditioning.
Make the most of daylight On bright days, avoid turning on lights before you need to.
Moderate heat Set the AC to 23°C — every degree lower increases consumption significantly.
Fan before AC On days like this, a fan already does the job and uses far less energy.
Extreme heat! Air conditioning tends to weigh heavily on your bill. Keep doors and windows closed to retain cool air.
Refrigerator Avoid opening the fridge often — it works harder to stay cool on hot days.
Rainy day Avoid drying clothes indoors with a fan on — use the clothesline once the rain stops.
Storm ahead Unplug sensitive devices to avoid damage from power surges.
Fog Foggy days tend to be colder — pay extra attention to shower time.
